metadata.description: Comprehensive SEO analysis plugin for OpenCode and Claude Code. 26 sub-skills and 19 sub-agents. v3.0.0 adds native OpenCode support: generated skills and agents, slash commands, a local plugin, background subagents, MCP configuration, and a lightweight OpenCode CI target. Claude Code and other harnesses remain supported.
